hero.title: Hi, I'm Carlos Hernández
hero.paragraphOne: I build web applications, APIs, and digital experiences that work.
hero.paragraphTwo: I focus on frontend, backend, test automation, and cloud solutions.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.paragraphOne: I approach interfaces, APIs, and data as connected parts of the same application.
architecture.paragraphTwo: I define workflows, responsibilities, and contracts between components so a product can grow while remaining clear and maintainable.

frontend.title: Frontend
frontend.paragraphOne: I build responsive web and mobile interfaces with JavaScript and TypeScript, primarily using Angular, Vue, and React Native.
frontend.paragraphTwo: I integrate APIs and pay attention to components, state, and interactions so every screen is useful and easy to maintain.

backend.title: Backend
backend.paragraphOne: I build endpoints and integrate services that connect applications to their data and business logic.
backend.paragraphTwo: I'm currently deepening my knowledge of Node.js and NestJS, focusing on validation, error handling, and authentication.

persistence.title: Data Persistence
persistence.paragraphOne: I design relational data models and work with PostgreSQL and MySQL to support each feature's requirements.
persistence.paragraphTwo: I write queries and examine how data relates before connecting it to an API or an interface.
persistence.paragraphThree: I use Docker and Docker Compose to run databases and development services in reproducible local environments.

testing.title: Testing
testing.paragraphOne: I turn product requirements and workflows into testable scenarios, test matrices, and test plans.
testing.paragraphTwo: This helps identify edge cases and agree on what should work before a feature is considered complete.

automatedTesting.title: Automated Testing
automatedTesting.paragraphOne: I've worked with BDD scenarios and automated tests to check application behavior consistently.
automatedTesting.paragraphTwo: I use tools such as Cypress and Playwright depending on the project, aiming to make tests a reliable source of confidence when changing code.
